accepted_scope: The single fixed Wu manifold W = SU(3)/SO(3), with the real SO(3) inclusion, is an actual finite simply connected complex of rational homotopy type S^5. For arbitrary continuous free actions on this same space, its free toral rank and free 2-rank are zero and its free p-rank is one for every odd prime; every cyclic group of odd order acts freely and smoothly. This satisfies all the homotopy hypotheses and answers Hanke's printed 2010 existence question. Almost-free and rational toral ranks are different invariants.
priority_summary: Classical explanatory assembly; historical priority remains unresolved. Yeroshkin's circle action, Kuhn–Lloyd's explicit no-free-involution obstruction, and the classical Wu characteristic number in Debray–Yu with older credits are acknowledged. Mundet's 2021 v1 Theorem 1.14/Section 15 (published Theorem 1.11/Section 13) already gives actual free odd-prime cyclic actions on fixed CWY examples with no nontrivial continuous circle action; their nonabelian fundamental groups exclude Hanke's abelian-pi1 target. No complete predecessor satisfying every target hypothesis was verified in the bounded inspected statements. Older books, theses, journal versions and citation gaps remain. No firstness, novelty, absence theorem or current worldwide-open certification.
